floor.what: each sampled memory window's coverage by the rest of the memory, its own episode excluded

training_maps_at_floor.what: every training map's coverage lies below every unseen map's

temporal_sensitivity.what: shuffling innovations against contexts raises every map's coverage

control_sensitivity.what: shuffling controls against transitions raises every map's coverage

state_share.what: state-only coverage over coverage: near 1 means the score is still appearance

memory_halves.what: coverage against two disjoint halves of the memory episodes ranks the maps alike

validation_inside_floor.what: every training map's target coverage lies inside the band of per-episode train-versus-train coverage
